stepTitle: Step 1: Rearrange Formula for Monthly Payment
stepBody:
The present value annuity formula is $P = x \cdot \frac{1 - (1+i)^{-n}}{i}$

Where:
- $P$ = loan amount (present value)
- $x$ = monthly payment
- $i$ = monthly interest rate
- $n$ = number of payments
